text: Swap one milk tea a week for water and you save over 1.5 million VND a year.
Never shop hungry. You buy up to 30% more when your stomach is empty.
Wait 72 hours before buying a want. Most of the urge will be gone.
Pay yourself first: move money to savings the day you get paid.
Write down every expense for one week. You'll be surprised where money goes.
Turn off shopping app notifications. Fewer sale alerts, fewer impulse buys.
Cooking at home 3 times a week can cut your food costs by a third.
Never share your OTP code with anyone, not even someone claiming to be the bank.
Give every savings goal a name and a date. Clear goals are easier to reach.
Walk or cycle short trips. It's free exercise and saves fuel money.
